Stockport remain without long-term absentee Brad Hills, who is working on his rehabilitation from an anterior cruciate ligament injury.

Defender Kyron Gordon is also unavailable for selection after missing the last four matches with a hamstring problem. [...] Midfielder Alistair Smith is available for selection after missing the midweek EFL Trophy defeat through suspension.

Stockport County possible starting lineup:

Whatmuff; Jobe, O’Connell, Pye; Glover, Bate, Norwood, Osborn; Wood, Diamond; Wootton

AFC Wimbledon possible starting lineup:

Bursik; Tilley, Yiadom, Johnson, Seddon, Sasu; Smith, Harrison, Hippolyte; Stockley, Cornick
